intents: read Synthesis topics, graphs, indexes, resolvers, artifacts, schemas, or attention queues
useWhen: The requested fact belongs to the Synthesis model rather than raw Zotero metadata.
avoidWhen: Do not assume cached Synthesis projections are current Zotero write state.
evidence: topic, graph, index, resolver, artifact, schema, or insight result with paging metadata

intents: resolve tags, collections, or paper refs into a bounded paper set
avoidWhen: Do not wrap selectors in a resolver object or use resolver output as live Zotero selection.

intents: invalidate a supported Synthesis cache scope
useWhen: Read-only cache status shows stale derived data and the user can review the maintenance action.
evidence: pre-invalidation status, approval outcome, and post-invalidation status
